description.value: Samz is a retail liquor store co-located with a neighbourhood pub at a single address in Port Coquitlam, part of a two-location Lower Mainland chain (also in Surrey). The store carries beer, wine, and spirits and markets itself on selection and competitive pricing relative to BC Government Liquor Stores. Touring cyclists passing through PoCo can stop in for supplies at the attached liquor store or grab a meal at the adjoining pub.

address.value: 2342 Elgin Avenue, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C 2B5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Samz operates a combined pub and liquor store at 2342 Elgin Avenue, Port Coquitlam — matching the OSM address exactly. The OSM phone (+1-604-461-1179) matches the liquor store phone listed on the website (604-461-1179), confirming the record is specifically for the liquor store portion. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all such fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Samz Liquor Store' but the website brand is 'Samz Neighbourhood Pub' — the liquor store is one component of a combined pub+liquor store operation at this address.
Website still carries a COVID19 safety page, suggesting some content is dated, though the business is confirmed open per OSM check_date 2026-02-06.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible retail liquor store with a confirmed address and operating website; useful to touring cyclists for resupply.
